properties.description: Built 2026-10-20 (reasoning.rs reasoning_neighbours, support_closure; reason_to_exist.rs chain_rests_on; inference.rs replaced_by). reasoning_report on a requirement walks each Decision it is GOVERNED_BY that a chain concludes, and its rests_on holds that chain's terminal premises; reason_to_exist names them (`chain_rests_on`, with any `confidence`); a requirement whose reason stands is not listed unsupported. A claim another replaces (OBSOLETES from a live statement) reads unknown, "replaced by". Source grade and analytic confidence as fields are phase 6 PR 4.
